messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 429s from rate-limiter service in us-west-2. Alert group: ratecap.policy.enforcement. See /incidents/1859001234
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-15-rlv2 started at 1859001200, batch=canary-2 -> applying new exemption matcher rules
olivia: I'm oncall, jumping in. Can folks paste the top error? I see customer tickets coming in.
raj: Top error from edge logs: `quota_exempt=false` on requests that should be exempted (enterprise accounts). Looks like matcher not matching account tag after rollout.
maria: Confirming logs from canary hosts show policy compiled without the `enterprise_tag` clause. Possibly a feature-flag gated config change.
sam-eng: I rolled the policy change through the canary pipeline earlier this morning. CLI diff attached: ```diff
- match: account.tag == "enterprise"
+ match: account.metadata.tags CONTAINS "enterprise"
``` 
sam-eng: That CONTAINS helper isn't available in the runtime kernel we compiled for canary-2. It silently yielded false for all accounts instead of throwing.
olivia: Ok that explains missing exemptions. Impact: enterprise customers hitting hard 429s for tokenized APIs. alex-support, do we have a list of affected accounts?
alex-support: Yes — support thread: https://redwood/support/INC-8421. Top affected: AcmeCorp, NovaApps, Finlytics. They're seeing large request failures since 08:12 PDT.
raj: Immediate mitigation options: 1) flip canary rollback/abort, 2) temporary global bypass rule for enterprise org IDs, 3) flip feature flag to disable new matcher behavior. Which is fastest?
lindsey-sre: Abort canary-2 in rollout console? deploy-bot, can you stop the canary and prevent promotion?
deploy-bot: Stopping canary-2... command: `deployctl rollout abort --id=2026-03-15-rlv2 --batch=canary-2` -> in progress
deploy-bot: Abort succeeded. Canary-2 controllers drained new configs. No automatic rollback applied to production batches yet.
olivia: Good. Next, we should apply a hotfix to restore enterprise exemptions while we patch the CONTAINS helper. Raj, can you apply a temporary bypass rule in rate-limiter config: match org_id in [list] -> exempt?
raj: I can push a scoped exemption via runtime admin API. Pushing now:
```
POST /admin/ratecap/exempt
{ "org_ids": ["acmecorp","novaapps","finlytics"], "reason": "hotfix - matcher regression" }
```
raj: Response: 200, exemptions applied. Verifying logs.
maria: I see exemptions showing on rate-limiter metrics. Error rate for enterprise buckets dropping within one minute :white_check_mark:
alex-support: Customer contacts updated: support notified AcmeCorp and NovaApps of mitigation and that we're actively patching. SLA impact message drafted.
sam-eng: While exemptions are live, I'll prepare a quick rollback patch to revert matcher to previous behavior (use == check). Planning PR now.
olivia: If PR is small, can we patch and roll through canary-1 before full rollout? We need to ensure kernel compatibility.
raj: Suggestion: keep the admin exemptions for 30m minimum, patch runtime to return to `==` behavior, validate on canary-1, then roll forward. Also schedule a feature-flag kill-switch in case of any further mismatch.
lindsey-sre: I'll add an incident tag and start tracking all actions in the incident runbook. Current severity: sev-2 until full rollback and verification.
deploy-bot: Canary-1 rollout for patch queued: `deployctl rollout start --id=2026-03-15-rlv2-patch --batch=canary-1`
deploy-bot: Canary-1 succeeded on 3/3 hosts. Monitoring 5m.
maria: Metrics show sustained low 429s for enterprise after canary-1 patch. No new regressions on canary hosts.
olivia: Proceed to promote patch to remaining hosts but keep canary gating slow. Please do not enable the CONTAINS helper flag yet.
sam-eng: Promoting patch now. NOTE: I'm disabling the feature flag `rl_new_matcher_v2` in the flags service as an extra safeguard.
sam-eng: Command: `flagsctl set rl_new_matcher_v2 false --env=prod --note='disable until kernel support added'`
sam-eng: Flag flip acknowledged by feature-flag service :white_check_mark:
alex-support: Customers updated: notification that a config rollback and temporary exemption were applied. ETA for full verification: 30-45m.
lindsey-sre: Oncall handoff scheduled: olivia -> lindsey in 35 minutes. lindsey, will you take second-level post-rollback checks?
olivia: Yes, I'll hand off and include the runbook pointer. Leaving the incident to monitor for 1hr and then wrap.
incident-bot: Incident 1859001234 updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2, owner=olivia, linked_ticket=INC-8421
raj: Postmortem action items: 1) add compile-time validation for matcher helpers, 2) add fallback behavior to treat unknown helpers as errors not false, 3) add integration tests against real runtime kernels.
maria: Also add a playbook entry for scoped admin exemptions and flag kill-switch steps.
olivia: Great. Closing notes: mitigation sequence — abort canary, apply scoped exemptions, patch matcher to previous semantics, disable new feature flag, promote patch. Impact: enterprise customers saw elevated 429s for ~18 minutes, mitigated within ~9 minutes after abort+exempt. Will assign postmortem owners.
alex-support: I'll keep support escalations open until 2hr stability window completes.
lindsey-sre: Handoff: taking on-call at 1859003210. Acknowledge and monitoring. :eyes:
olivia: Thanks team. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign; link will be posted here when ready.
incident-bot: Incident 1859001234 resolved timestamp=1859001440, resolution=rollback+hotfix+flag-off
olivia: Postmortem doc: https://redwood/pm/1859001234-postmortem (assigned to raj, sam-eng, maria). Closing thread.
alex-support: Marking support tickets as resolved when customers confirm!
